figures.claim: 1. Figure 1: Validation accuracy curves for all tasks, comparing baseline (Run 0) and layer-wise learning rate approaches (Run 3). Subfigures: (a) Modular Division, (b) Modular Subtraction, (c) Modular Addition, (d) Permutation.
figures.explanation: Execution stage: The all_results.npy files required by plot.py to regenerate Figure 1 are missing from all run directories. The pre-existing PNG files cannot serve as Verified evidence per policy. Full training reproduction to generate all_results.npy is not feasible, leaving the figure claim unverifiable.
